newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's tourism to rise 3-6 pct in 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's tourism to rise 3-6 pct in 1997 - paper.

text.p: Tourism in Portugal should increase by between 3.0 and 6.0 percent this year compared with 1996, Secretary of State for Tourism Jaime Andrez told the weekly Expresso.
Andrez said 10 million tourists took holidays in Portugal last year, slightly more than in 1995.

He said the fact that more Portuguese were going on holiday in their own country had compensated for a slump in foreign bookings. British tourists stayed away from Portuguese beaches in droves last year because of job insecurity and a strong escudo.
The secretary of state said Portugal would use Lisbon's Expo '98 world exhibition, which opens in May 1998, to promote the country's other attractions.
"Expo '98 is going to bring in a huge number of visitors but we must use it as a springboard for our tourism potential," he said.
Economy Minister Augusto Mateus said recently that 13 million visitors would come to Portugal in 1998.
